```artifact
Feature: Manage Doctors and Chemists in VCMS

  Scenario: Add and edit doctor details
  Given a VCMS with no existing doctors
  When I attempt to add a new doctor
  Then the system should display "Speciality does not exist"

  Scenario Outline: Adding a new doctor
  Given a VCMS with no existing doctors
  When I attempt to add a new doctor with <Doctor Id>
  Then the system should display "Speciality does not exist"

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
    | 12345     | John Doe    | 40  | M   | MD           | 10       |
    | 67890     | Jane Doe    | 35  | F   | PhD          | 5        |

  Scenario: Edit doctor details
  Given a VCMS with existing doctors
  When I attempt to edit a doctor with <Doctor Id>
  Then the system should display doctor details

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Experience | Qualification |
    | 12345     | John Doe    | 40  | M   | 10         | MD           |
    | 67890     | Jane Doe    | 35  | F   | 5          | PhD          |

  Scenario: Delete doctor details
  Given a VCMS with existing doctors
  When I attempt to delete a doctor with <Doctor Id>
  Then the system should check for open consultation requests

  Examples:
    | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Experience | Qualification |
    | 12345     | John Doe    | 40  | M   | 10         | MD           |
    | 67890     | Jane Doe    | 35  | F   | 5          | PhD          |

  Scenario: Manage chemists and labs
  Given a VCMS with no existing chemists or labs
  When I attempt to add a new chemist or lab
  Then the system should add the new chemist or lab

  Scenario Outline: Adding a new chemist or lab
  Given a VCMS with no existing chemists or labs
  When I attempt to add a new chemist or lab with <Chemist/Lab Id>
  Then the system should add the new chemist or lab

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 12345     | true           | Chemist Lab 1    | Chemist Lab Address 1 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 1 |
    | 67890     | false          | Chemist Lab 2    | Chemist Lab Address 2 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 2 |

  Scenario: Edit chemist or lab details
  Given a VCMS with existing chemists or labs
  When I attempt to edit a chemist or lab with <Chemist/Lab Id>
  Then the system should edit the chemist or lab details

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 12345     | true           | Chemist Lab 1    | Chemist Lab Address 1 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 1 |
    | 67890     | false          | Chemist Lab 2    | Chemist Lab Address 2 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 2 |

  Scenario: Delete chemist or lab details
  Given a VCMS with existing chemists or labs
  When I attempt to delete a chemist or lab with <Chemist/Lab Id>
  Then the system should check for open consultation requests

  Examples:
    | Chemist/Lab Id | Chemist Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
    | 12345     | true           | Chemist Lab 1    | Chemist Lab Address 1 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 1 |
    | 67890     | false          | Chemist Lab 2    | Chemist Lab Address 2 | Chemist Lab Contact Details 2 |
```
